_comment: Hand-authored lore-hub settlement list (board #3665). One row per named hub: `state` is a human label (logs only), `hub` is city|port|farm|mine|wood, `name` is the display text, `anchor` is a canvas [x,y] pixel that generate_provinces.py seeds a distinct province at and generate_land_regions.py picks as that state's hub. Identity is the anchor geometry, never a stored STATE_ key. This is the proving slice (#3665 AC-8): 5 Empire provincial capitals as city hubs, carried end-to-end before the realm children (#3666+) fill in every state's five hubs.
